the plasmonic nanoparticles in the blocking layer act like an optical antenna that enhances the light absorption and guides the light into the porous photoanode, thereby enhancing the efficiency of the cell.

the plasmonic nanoparticles can be integrated into the blocking layer by a facile method and can be used as an alternative to the conventional plasmonic nanoparticles, thus simplifying the fabrication process of the cell and reducing its cost.

the concept of plasmonically enhanced DSSCs is not limited to a dye-sensitizer and that the plasmonic effect can be exploited by the blocking layer itself, which is the most crucial part of the cell, as it controls the charge transport.
